$comment: Version revocation list read by the bamboohr-mcp start-up self-check (task 10). Organisations should host their own copy on an internal HTTPS endpoint and point BAMBOOHR_REVOCATION_URL / `enroll --revocation-url` at it. A version listed in revokedVersions, or lower than minimumVersion, serves no data and tells the user to update.
message: Versions before 4.2.0 can read sensitive BambooHR tables (earnings, passports, visas, credit cards, COVID records) and may return home email addresses. Install the latest release: https://github.com/mikkmihkel/bamboohr-mcp/releases/latest
